note: w29n game-symbol rename table (static_rename format; only 'accepted' rows apply; `batch` = the lane that applied the row: w29n (27 rows: 22 functions, 5 data; wave 29), w30n (the 10 rows deferred by w29n until their fixtures moved; wave 30), w32n (19 GC names for the high-score, results, save/ghost, hud, options, audio and controls screens; wave 32). replay.sh applies one batch: RENAME_BATCH=w29n|w30n|w32n). Evidence per row; mapping table with GC sources in docs/external/gc/names.md.
